findings.title: Payment terms
findings.deviation: Invoices payable within 30 days of receipt of invoice (45 days maximum); no pay-when-paid; set-off limited to undisputed amounts under this agreement.
findings.impact: The agreement allows for 30 days of payment, which is acceptable. However, the maximum of 45 days is higher than the playbook's maximum of 31-45 days.
findings.clauseRef: 7.2 Invoices under this Agreement shall be raised by AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3, on or after Acceptance of each milestone as set out in Schedule B. TravelHub shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date by wire transfer to the bank account specified on the invoice.

findings.title: Limitation of liability
findings.deviation: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality; data-protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g. 2× fees).
findings.impact: The agreement caps liability at 1× fees, which is acceptable. However, the carve-outs are more limited than the playbook's requirement to include confidentiality breaches.
findings.clauseRef: 12.2 Each Party's total liability arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, except for breach of confidentiality or wilful misconduct.

findings.title: Indemnity
findings.deviation: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence; indemnities subject to the liability cap (IP infringement excepted).
findings.impact: The agreement provides for mutual indemnity, which is acceptable. However, the carve-outs are more limited than the playbook's requirement to include negligence.
findings.clauseRef: 13.1 AtliQ shall defend and indemnify TravelHub against third-party claims alleging that the Deliverables infringe any intellectual property right. 13.2 TravelHub shall defend and indemnify AtliQ against third-party claims arising from Customer Data or TravelHub's use of the Deliverables in breach of applicable law.

findings.clauseRef: 10.1 Upon full payment, TravelHub shall own all right, title and interest in the Deliverables developed specifically for TravelHub, including the trained models and model weights for the Itinerary Personalization Engine and Partner Hotel Ranking Module. 10.2 AtliQ retains ownership of its Background Technology and grants TravelHub a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use any Background Technology incorporated in the Deliverables as part of the TravelHub App.

findings.title: Termination
findings.deviation: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs; mutual notice period.
findings.impact: The agreement provides for mutual notice periods, which is acceptable. However, the payment terms are more generous than the playbook's requirement to pay only for accepted deliverables.
findings.clauseRef: 8.3 TravelHub may terminate for convenience with thirty (30) days' written notice and shall pay for all work performed up to the termination date.
